verdict.rationale: The quickstart onboarding lets you pick a model source of your ChatGPT/Codex subscription, SuperGrok subscription, or Slate credits. That suggests you can use an existing personal subscription or account credits rather than managing raw API keys. Nothing shows a free tier, and the sign-in flow is only implied, not documented in detail. Missing for 10: evidence of free-tier access, explicit documentation of the personal-account sign-in/auth flow, confirmation that no API keys are needed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
